verdict.rationale: cubic ships an official CLI that reviews local changes before you push. It finds bugs and produces a fix prompt for a coding agent, which covers the local-diff part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows the CLI running in CI scripts or emitting structured, machine-readable output that tooling can consume. Missing for 10: documented CI/script usage (non-interactive mode, exit codes), machine-readable output format such as JSON or SARIF, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I run reviews from a CLI against local diffs or in CI scripts, with machine-readable output my tooling can consume

citations.quote: The cubic CLI reviews local changes before you push. It finds bugs and generates a prompt that your coding agent can use to fix them.
